sources.quote: BD+20°594b is a sub-Neptune exoplanet discovered by the Kepler space telescope in collaboration with the HARPS spectrometer at La Silla in Chile.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around BD+20 594. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
